description:
One fallible binding API cutover includes its mechanically migrated implementations and inventoried callers.

## Background

`IssueStore::configure_repository_layout` and `CommandExecutor::with_layout` currently bind without returning mismatch errors. The investigation inventories implementations and callers.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Layout binding returns an error before side effects when roots differ, preserving same-root refresh and recovery ordering; callers propagate errors and tests cover mismatch and same-root binding.

## Notes

See `dev/active/0f8efc37-frontends-share-core/plan.md` and its linked investigation for scope and existing consumers.
title: Reject incompatible repository layout bindings
